description: Approve or reject one mapping Rosetta held back, by id from list_rosetta_review. Pass action approve or reject, and reviewer to say who decided, otherwise the workspace is recorded. A decision is final: an item already decided answers 409. An agent or key that queued the item cannot decide it: that answers 403, and a person or a different agent or key decides. It sends the review-resolved webhook to the workspace's endpoints. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

action.description: Approve the mapping or reject it.

id.description: The review item id from list_rosetta_review.

reviewer.description: Who decided. Defaults to the workspace.

name: decide_rosetta_review
